# The Urlcade

> A URL-encoded virtual console: every game cartridge is fully described by
> the URL fragment on its link, decoded and run by a single self-contained
> HTML runtime. No server, no build step, no install — copy a link, the
> recipient gets the exact game.

## Ground truth (read this first)

The actual binary cart format, opcode table, and bytecode VM live in
running code, not prose — and the prose below is design history that
can lag the code (it says so itself). If you're authoring or decoding
a cart programmatically, start here, not with DESIGN.md:

- [kernel.js](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/kernel.js): The exact `encodeCart`/`decodeCart`/opcode table/assembler/VM/compression, extracted verbatim from the runtime into one dependency-free file. Runs standalone under Node or any JS host — no browser, no network, no build step (`const K = require('./kernel.js')`).
- [fixtures.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/fixtures.md): Known-good (cart description → exact bytes → exact fragment string) examples generated by kernel.js. Check your own implementation against these directly — nothing here requires running anything.

## Spec & reference runtime

- [DESIGN.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/DESIGN.md): The design history — binary cart layout, the stack-machine VM and opcode table, and the composable generators (palette/map/HUD/camera/aim-line) shared across cart types, in the order they were built. Narrative, not guaranteed current — see kernel.js above for the literal, current format.
- [v0-README.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/v0-README.md): What the V0 reference runtime actually built against the spec, including real bugs found and fixed and deliberate V0 scope cuts.

## Worked examples

- [examples/flappy-bird.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/examples/flappy-bird.md): Dogfooding the format against a Flappy Bird clone.
- [examples/race-car.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/examples/race-car.md): Dogfooding the format against a top-down racer.
- [examples/three-more-carts.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/examples/three-more-carts.md): Design-level sketches for a roguelike, a platformer, and an arena shooter.

## Try it

- [Play](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/): The live runtime with five playable cartridges (Flappy Bird, a racer, a roguelike, a platformer, and a physics-based castle-crusher).
